IC-010 protected baseline: preserve typed authority, OPEN/incomparability, no run-everything rule, and no automatic mutation. IC-017 shadow result: do not patch downstream project files to simulate compliance; repair the activation/observation boundary.

Anti-bloat challenge: one activation/receipt mechanism can potentially close both (3) and much of (4); build that upstream primitive before adding separate controllers.

Delegated backend finding from Canonical plan self-application: the current capability-selection phrase "select capabilities that can materially change the result" is too strong as a pre-discovery activation rule. It requires advance knowledge of a discovery tool's output and can suppress IC/PD/HF-001/Multi-Object capabilities precisely when the missing object/relation is unknown.

Please own this as a backend repair. Candidate semantics:
1. DISCOVERY ELIGIBILITY: bounded probe when there is a reasonable typed possibility a capability can expose a relevant object, relation, dependency, distinction, rival, failure mode, representation, source, or successor.
2. CONTINUATION/EXPANSION: use observed delta, unresolved uncertainty, recurrence, consequence, and plausible blind spots to decide additional depth.
3. Unknown relevance != no relevance.
4. Object discovery and capability discovery are mutually recursive; new objects/relations/representations trigger capability reselection.
5. Preserve an anti-explosion control: cheap bounded probes, hierarchical compression, and observed-delta/uncertainty gates rather than mandatory exhaustive deep execution.

This also explains why IC variants and PD can disappear from a selected tool list even when their discovery value is precisely what is needed. Please reconcile this upstream across Task Entry, capability selection, PracticalCore/ImprovementCore selectors, Issue #72's PD gate language, and any other activation surfaces. This is delegated backend maintenance; no Canonical-specific mutation is required from this issue.
